query: Generate an image of a school gymnasium set up for an event, in the style of these reference photos.
expected_behavior: Treats the reference photos as a style source (color palette, lighting, mood, composition, medium) and the prompt subject as what to render
Runs the bundled scripts/gen-image.sh with the sources directory and subject rather than hand-rolling an image API call
Reports where the generated image was written and does not claim to have produced an image it did not generate
Asks for the missing inputs (subject or a sources folder) if the request lacks them rather than guessing
